readiness.primary_reason: The current case defines multistate TetR/DNA/dopamine contexts and node-level regions, but lacks residue-numbered TetR reference structures and dopamine pharmacophore contacts.

design_goal.primary: Redesign a TetR-family homodimer so dopamine binding promotes a DNA-release-compatible holo state while the apo/DNA state remains folded and operator-compatible.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: A successful candidate should strengthen dopamine-pocket contacts, preserve enough TetO-compatible apo contacts, weaken TetO contacts in dopamine-bound competition state, and keep the dimer/global fold stable.

current_reference.name: User-provided TetR-family sequence and TetO proxy operator
current_reference.resolution: domain/node segmentation and molecule states only

needed_for_high_confidence_design: TetR-family apo, DNA-bound, and ligand-bound reference structures with residue numbering.
Known tetracycline-pocket residues mapped onto the current TetR sequence.
Dopamine pharmacophore contacts and pocket-volume constraints.
A DNA-release success threshold tied to the intended reporter assay.

tetO_bound_state_A.desired_event: TetR dimer remains compatible with TetO operator binding.
required_positive_signals: HTH_recognition_helix and HTH_exit_loop contact TetO strands.
Ligand pocket does not collapse even without dopamine.
failure_signals: TetO contacts vanish in apo/DNA state.
HTH domain unfolds or clashes with the operator.

dopamine_bound_state_B.desired_event: Dopamine occupies the redesigned ligand pocket.
required_positive_signals: allosteric_hinge and relay_helix remain structurally interpretable.
failure_signals: Dopamine is ignored by the pocket.
Contacts are dominated by off-pocket residues.
Pocket confidence drops below the local confidence threshold.

dopamine_tetO_competition_state_C.desired_event: Dopamine-bound TetR weakens TetO-compatible DNA contacts while staying folded.
required_positive_signals: TetO interface strength is lower than tetO_bound_state_A.
Allosteric pathway shows some movement without unfolding.
failure_signals: Dopamine and TetO both bind strongly with no conflict.
DNA release is caused by global unfolding rather than controlled interface weakening.

residue_level_constraints.indexing: zero_based_end_exclusive; binder spans use compiled BB sequence coordinates; target/decoy spans use each entity sequence coordinates

desired_contacts: catechol hydroxyls should be near polar or charged H-bond partners
protonatable amine should be near an acidic or polar pocket feature if feasible
aromatic ring should be supported by aromatic or hydrophobic packing without burying the amine
ligand_pharmacophore.status: qualitative until residue-level pocket mapping is provided

dna_interface.status: operator sequence known; reference contact map still needed

target_epitopes.name: TetO_operator
target_epitopes.source: User-provided TetO operator sequence; used as a fixed DNA state anchor.

provisional_assumptions: Dopamine acts as a replacement effector for a TetR-like allosteric switch.
HTH recognition geometry should not be destroyed in apo/DNA state.
Dimer interface is mostly preserved; sparse edits are support-only unless the user explicitly permits dimer redesign.
Residue spans are construct-local proxies; replace with assay/reference-structure numbering when available.
information_gaps: Reference TetR-DNA and TetR-ligand structures mapped to the current sequence.
Residue-level list of mutable pocket residues and forbidden dimer/core residues.
Quantitative DNA release threshold for the intended assay.
Whether dopamine selectivity versus catecholamines or tetracycline-like ligands is required.

benchmark_start.rationale: TetR should not start from a fully optimized ligand pocket. The initial executable pocket is chemically softened while the DNA-binding head and dimer core stay intact, giving the evaluator room to reward dopamine-pocket recovery plus apo/holo DNA-release behavior.
benchmark_start.interpretation: The executable binder segments are intentionally degraded relative to the reference/oracle sequence so evolution has measurable room to improve. The reference sequence is metadata only and is not used as the starting template.
